component.name: Glimmerwood
component.summary: The web browser that's on your side

description.p: Glimmerwood is a quiet web browser with a small living companion. The wisp, a glowing flame with a friendly face, notices how your time online really feels: it brightens somewhere that restores you, clouds over during a long scroll, and perks up again when you step away. It never blocks a page or scolds you.

ul.li: Hover the wisp to see, in plain words, what is moving it
Home: a garden that grows on good days and never wilts, a greeting that notices what went well, and good places to go
The wisp's days: today, the week and the weeks before, with no minutes or scores
About 2,300 sites sorted by published research on wellbeing online, and yours to change
Private by design: nothing leaves your computer, and the addresses you visit are never recorded

screenshot.caption: The wisp, bright on a page that restores you
Home, with a garden that grows on good days

description.p: Settings, and a wisp that asks how new places leave you.

ul.li: On a site that's on none of its lists, the wisp asks once how the place leaves you, with a slider from drains me to restores me
A Settings page (Ctrl+comma) to look up and rate any site, change your ratings, choose when the night starts and ends, and see every keyboard shortcut
Ratings are kept in your own reputation.toml, and comments you write there by hand are kept

description.p: Wisp is now called Glimmerwood, since another web browser already goes by Wisp. The companion is still the wisp.

ul.li: A new app ID, io.github.peterwalker78.Glimmerwood, so it installs beside Wisp 0.1.0 rather than over it
Settings, history and bookmarks live under glimmerwood instead of wisp
The wisp, with its moods, moss and a caption that explains what moves it
Home with its garden, greeting, good places, bookmarks and the wisp's days
Tabs in a resizable column, find in page, HTTPS first and tracking protection
